tagline: Soligor数码单反相机，1994 年发布
description: Soligor于1994年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度Quartz-controlled focal plane shutter, speeds 4 sec. to 1/1000 sec. (auto) and 1 sec. to 1/1000 sec. (manual)。使用35mm。

specs.卡口: Minolta SR-bayonet with aperture release tappet for Minolta MC and MD lenses
specs.快门: Quartz-controlled focal plane shutter, speeds 4 sec. to 1/1000 sec. (auto) and 1 sec. to 1/1000 sec. (manual)
specs.取景器: pentaprism finder, screen with micro-prism and split image for distance setting
specs.曝光测光: Integral center-weighted measuring with photo diode
specs.自拍: Electronic timer with red LED signal
specs.英文简介: The Soligor SR-300 MD is a compact SLR camera body with a Minolta MD SR-bayonet mount.
